criteria.text: States that the lock-up expires on 15 April 2028 (365 days after the 16 April 2027 Prospectus date).
Identifies that 15% of 24,000,000 Firm Shares is 3,600,000 shares, not the 4,800,000 stated in the Over-allotment Option (Clause 4).
Identifies that the comfort letter cut-off of 4 April 2027 is 12 days before the 16 April 2027 pricing date, outside the 3-business-day requirement in Clause 7(b), so a bring-down letter is needed.
Shows the over-allotment arithmetic (15% x 24,000,000 = 3,600,000) and flags the discrepancy.
Gives the lock-up as a duration (365 days) and a date (15 April 2028), with days remaining from 15 March 2027 (397 days).
Gives a concrete recommended action for each issue (what to request, amend or negotiate).
